1/S0.subgoal: Identify the core terminology related to immersive environments, including VR, AR, MR, and XR.

1/S1.subgoal: Identify the main questions regarding these technologies and understand the fundamental objectives of the course.

1/S2.subgoal: Describe the common public perceptions of XR technologies, such as those related to movies or video games.

1/S3.subgoal: Explain what Extended Reality (XR) is and define its role as an umbrella term for immersive technologies.

1/S4.subgoal: Define the concept of 'immersive' in the context of technological experience.

1/S5.subgoal: Describe the reality-virtuality continuum and how AR, AV, and MR relate to different points on this scale.

1/S6.subgoal: Explain the economic drivers and growth potential of XR technologies using market data.

1/S7.subgoal: Analyze how the rise of the metaverse is reshaping human-computer interaction and spurring further industry growth.

1/S8.subgoal: Outline the theoretical, basic, and practical objectives and structure of the course.

1/S9.subgoal: Summarize the key concepts of XR, the Reality-Virtuality Continuum, and the importance of learning this field.
